title: claw chart values
description: Constrains the background-shell keys, the Doorbell dispatch switches and the eight admission ceilings. Scoped deliberately and additionalProperties left open throughout: helm applies a schema to the whole merged values document, so a whitelist would reject every other value key and break the first upgrade after this schema shipped.

backgroundShell.description: Enable background shell tools. Also tightens the foreground bash ceiling; pin brain.bashMaxTimeoutSec to decouple them.

keepaliveTargetCeiling.description: Largest number of distinct keepalive ping targets one Brain replica may face. Required when backgroundShell is true; Brain refuses to start without it rather than substituting a number the refresh-gap relation was never proven at.

keepaliveIdleDeadlineSec.description: Shortest idle reclaim in force, in seconds. Required when backgroundShell is true: Brain proves the worst-case refresh gap against it at startup and refuses to start if the gap is not under it.

keepaliveReconcileReserve.description: Slots held back from ordinary admission so a target another replica created can be taken on before it is served. Required when backgroundShell is true, and must be below keepaliveTargetCeiling.

runDoorbellDispatch.description: Chat dispatch publishes a doorbell instead of a full execute request.

brainDoorbellExecution.description: A Brain replica executes doorbell runs, on the wire and from claim-next.

runFatPreparingReconcile.description: The API asserts every Brain takes a durable SQL holder before its execution gate.

bashMaxTimeoutSec.description: Foreground bash ceiling in seconds. Empty means the code default, which depends on features.backgroundShell. Zero is excluded because Brain refuses a ceiling below 1 at startup, so admitting it here moves the failure from helm to a crash-looping pod.
